inspection_findings: D01 conditionally compares NIR diffuse reflection and Raman probes in the feed frame. S01 pp.14-15 supplies the API/powder application and measurement concepts; p.5 supplies general method context; T01 rows 9/13 remain in the ledger as qualitative geometry/comparison guidance.
D01 separates the sourced 785 nm Raman excitation from an unknown Raman shift/coverage interval. No nominal NIR wavelength band or customer equipment coverage is invented.

D01 questions cover API identity/range, acceptable error, response time, installation conditions and reference-assay details. Examples inside questions are requests for clarification, not asserted customer facts or established reference methods.
D02 chooses a conditional NIR diffuse-reflection concept for opaque concentrated milk, supported by S01 p.17. It retains p.18 transmission limitations rather than inventing a dilute customer stream.
D02 questions cover response time, error, composition range and reference assays; temperature/texture variability remains in the customer facts and proposed samples.

Both experiments use representative acceptable/off-spec material, independent aligned laboratory references, individual-method comparisons and held-out independent batches/runs. Combination is proposed only if it improves the client-defined decision.
Assertions retain source scope and exact excerpt text; assumptions and all sample choices are hypotheses/proposals. Neither result approves hardware or promises performance.
general_corrections: Versioned extraction-v7 reinforces contiguous exact quotes, capitalization, preserved phrases and separation of concentration/appearance from sample phase; extraction validation was not weakened.

Versioned synthesis-v8 constrains assertion text, reference IDs, method families, independent-unit validation and source-available spectral intervals in the provider schema, with local reference/excerpt checks.
Known/unknown range variants and separate labeled Raman quantities prevent excitation, penetration depth and unsupported nominal bands being substituted for coverage.

limitations: This is an F05 development result. F06 comprehensive validation, synthesis repair, feasibility completion and public assessment API remain unimplemented.
